verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Riskified receives chargeback data through the chargeback endpoint and gateway integrations (CGI). It frames this as chargeback handling and dispute automation under its guarantee, not as outcome feedback that retrains models or rules. Model calibration appears only as a one-off onboarding step, and nothing shows analyst review decisions feeding back into the system.

support.subject: As a risk analyst, my review decisions and confirmed fraud outcomes feed back into the model and rules, so the system learns from every case we work
